generation_policy.batch: training: one problem; evaluation: fixed contiguous problem batches from config
generation_policy.training_rng: continuous process RNG; checkpoint restores all RNG states
generation_policy.evaluation_rng: batch size 1: per-question seed; otherwise SHA256(evaluation seed, split, ordered batch question IDs); regenerate entire partial batch on resume; outer RNG restored
generation_policy.determinism: strict outside sampled top_p<1 generation; warn_only=True within that entire generate call, for ALL unsupported nondeterministic operations, not just cumsum; restore enabled and warn_only flags in finally
generation_policy.padding: retain first EOS; discard every subsequent token; EOS counts in loss

eos.policy: union of generation_config EOS, tokenizer EOS and verified im_end if present
